Rule1 fires because the ant negotiates with the stork and the dalmatian does not trade. Rule3 would defeat it, but the walrus's money is unknown, so Rule3 is not established. The stork then builds the power plant and Rule2 gives "the mouse does not shout at the beetle", which points to "disproved". Even if Rule3 were allowed to fire, the result would be "unknown", never "proved".

Submitted answer: proved. Verified answer: disproved (or at best unknown).
